answer: Under the vine, identity is earned rather than claimed — no proof, no seat at the table. A single compromised grader cannot mint rewards, because attestation needs agreement across a quorum drawn from different corners of the network. The meadow raises the attack from bribing one peer to capturing a rotating majority, and the cost of that majority grows with the network. The marble turns sybil resistance into bookkeeping: if the cost per fake exceeds the reward per fake, the attack dies.
